blocks.text: Upon receipt of a regulatory examination notice, the Compliance team initiates the exam preparation process. The response package must be prepared within 30 days of receiving the notice.
Legal, Finance, and Operations collect and compile their relevant documents in parallel within the first 20 days. Compliance reviews all collected materials and assembles the final exam package.
The General Counsel must review and approve the completed exam package before it is submitted to the regulator.
The final exam package must be submitted to the regulator no later than 2 business days before the scheduled examination date.

messages.text: Update: the General Counsel has delegated exam package approval authority to the Deputy General Counsel for routine regulatory exams. DGC approval is sufficient unless the examination involves a consent order or enforcement action.
